Of the 31 strains whose lipoteichoic acid structure has been measured, 23 have a deposited assembly and 8 do not. Three were found only under a different name: JCM 1149T as ATCC 14917, JCM 15950T as DSM 16041, and BL23 under Lacticaseibacillus paracasei after reclassification.

The three Lactobacillus delbrueckii strains that lack an assembly (ATCC 15808, Ads-5, LL78) are the whole of one study, which showed that phage binding depends on D-alanyl and alpha-glucose substitution. Structure and function are both on record for them; only the genome is missing.
